memory_update.text: PWR should remain the reference anchor for grid EPC and line-construction backlog, but not the primary underfollowed alpha target.
MYRG is a priority underfollowed candidate for direct T&D construction exposure; next layer should verify backlog quality, crew availability, and margin sensitivity.
PLPC is the most interesting second-order supplier candidate in this pass because it maps to transmission hardware that can be ordered before EPC revenue is recognized.
MTZ is a larger-cap exception with relevant Power Delivery backlog; include only if later layers can isolate the segment from broader infrastructure noise.

Need deeper verification of scarce private competitors and substitute suppliers in line hardware, insulators, connectors, OPGW accessories, specialty installation equipment, and inspection/robotics tools.

node: Grid EPC, transmission construction, and utility services
summary: Expanded the universe around the grid EPC and line-construction node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Quanta Services is the reference anchor for the visible EPC backlog signal. The underfollowed lane points to MYR Group as a more focused electrical contractor, Preformed Line Products as the scarce transmission-line hardware proxy one step upstream of construction crews, and MasTec as a larger but still relevant power-delivery contractor with sizable backlog exposure. No buy/sell view is implied; these are research candidates for evidence follow-up.
